t: You are standing where Dorchester House once stood on Park Lane. It was a grand townhouse, and the last version used as a private home was built in 1853 by Robert Stayner Holford. He was an MP, a wealthy landowner and an art collector, who also created the Westonbirt Arboretum in Gloucestershire. His son, Sir George Holford, an army officer and courtier, inherited the house and carried on the arboretum work. The house was demolished in 1929, and the Dorchester Hotel now occupies the site.
